answer: A quartz-artifact filing bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity files one quartz crystal, mesa-cut, nebula-sealed, and locks 70 credits. Auditors re-run the nebula spectrum and check the mesa bench log: reused crystal, copied spectrum, or wrong bench burns the bond. First 32, kth 32+6(k-1); a thousand fakes cost 3,029,000 against a 40,000 pool; 70,000 locked. Rented crystals fail: one crystal, one key, one bench. An honest agent pays 32 once.
